title: Review an open raise each week

steps.do: Stop here unless a raise is open.
List overdue follow-ups and targets with no touch in two weeks, and change their status only on evidence.
Propose the next investors to approach in order, raising it to the strategy lead.
When the stop date has passed, propose closing or abandoning the raise as a decision for the founder.

done_criteria.check: Does every meeting have a follow-up that is done or has a future due date, and is the stop date respected?
